parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation or universal birth-sex facility/screening rule is documented; cross-dressing is legal and courts have handled bias claims, including convictions for attacks on trans tourists and a police officer. Positive healthcare and asylum/recognition climate. Yet no comprehensive SOGI anti-discrimination law exists, services/housing discrimination is noted, transphobic violence continues, and northern political hostility, detention discrimination, and rule-of-law constraints leave residual exposure. Absence of resident-only machinery is discounted, and unsourced advocacy prevalence is not treated as universal exposure. On outing, consequences are mostly non-catastrophic but protection is patchy.
